heroAlt: Portrait of Engr. Peter John R. Bacani in a black suit, white shirt and navy tie, standing in a dark studio with floating holographic workflow nodes.

scenes.label: Engineer and Math Educator
scenes.text: A Registered Electronics Engineer and Certified Grades 6 to 12 Mathematics Teacher, I turn circuits, code and mathematics into working systems, from the first schematic to a tested prototype.

scenes.label: STEM Teacher
scenes.text: With more than 10 years in the classroom, I teach STEM so that students do not only learn the formulas. They design, test and build solutions of their own.

scenes.label: Hands-on Learning
scenes.text: I focus on project-based, hands-on learning that develops creativity, critical thinking and analytical skills, as students build real robots, circuits and prototypes.

scenes.label: Technology-Based Instruction
scenes.text: I use advanced, technology-based instruction, from simulations, programming and data analysis to AI tools, to make complex ideas clear and prepare students for the future.
